message.content: This portrait-oriented editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. In the foreground, a person with short dark hair, seen from the back and slightly from the left side, wears a light-blue collared shirt. They hold a black rectangular smartphone with both hands. The phone screen displays a central figure in a dark suit and blue tie standing before a white neoclassical building with columns. A red and white sphere sits at this figure's feet on the screen. The person holding the phone is positioned in front of a real-world version of the same white building. Large, stylized yellow text with a blue outline across the bottom reads "ReSHUFFLe" in a font reminiscent of a popular video game logo. Below this, "GO" appears in blue with a circular red, white, and black symbol inside the "O". At the top, yellow text reads: "RIZAL RAMLI TENTANG REKLAMASI: JANGAN SEMUA DIBAWA KE PRESIDEN". The magazine title "TEMPO" is in large white letters across the upper portion. A small barcode and date "18-24 JULI 2016" are in the bottom left corner.
